detail.title: Display device and method for fabricating display device
detail.abstract: A display device includes a display panel, a window on the display panel, and an adhesive member between the display panel and the window, wherein the window includes a base substrate and a light-shielding pattern layer, the base substrate including a first region overlapping the display panel, and a second region extending and protruding outward from the display panel, the light-shielding pattern layer being on the first region and the second region and including a groove adjacent to an outer surface of the display panel.
